arguments.name: operation
arguments.description: Docker operation to run; when omitted the step is skipped.

arguments.name: registry
arguments.description: Registry to log in to; required for the login operation.

arguments.name: username
arguments.description: Registry username for login; must be given together with password.

arguments.name: password
arguments.description: Registry password for login, passed through stdin; must be given together with username.

arguments.name: images
arguments.description: Images for pull, push or inspect: a list of image references or a docker build image mapping ({name: {image: ...}}).

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Source image reference for the tag operation.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Target image reference for the tag operation.

arguments.name: command
arguments.description: Docker subcommand (without 'docker') for the raw operation.

arguments.name: arguments
arguments.description: Additional string arguments passed to the raw Docker command.

outputs.name: skipped
outputs.description: True when no operation was given and the step was skipped.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Whether the Docker command succeeded (login, tag, raw).

outputs.name: exit_code
outputs.description: Exit code of the Docker command (login, tag, raw).

outputs.name: total
outputs.description: Number of images processed (pull, push, inspect).
